stories.title: "They're my angels."

Then two women who'd heard the crash and seen the smoke came running: Chelsea Vietor and Hope Gillaspie, who never stopped to weigh the risk. Together they helped him escape. "I had two angels there that helped me," Eastham said. "If it wasn't for them, I don't think I'd be here."
